name: Bu/cunzai de Ni, he Wo
source:
Accompany a mysterious girl in a world with a unique artistic style and linguistic charm. Explore the "individual" essence and discover the truth of the "world".

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873080]Steam[/url]]
translation:
陪伴一位神秘的女孩进入一个具有独特艺术风格和语言魅力的世界。探索“个体”的本质，发现“世界”的真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873080]Steam[/url]]
